competencyStatement: Describe the principles of minimizing hazards using Prevention-Through-Design (e.g., avoidance, elimination, substitution, safety design criteria for workplace facilities, machines, and practices)
placementNote: The frozen FCP-0 repository contains the canonical Domain/Competency blueprint but no authoritative D01 topic/subtopic StudyContent tree. Topic and subtopic placement are therefore intentionally unset rather than inferred.

candidateConcepts.rationale: Core competency concept covering anticipation and design-out of occupational hazards and risk.
Captures the competency's explicit avoidance principle without converting it into a question.
Represents designing the hazard out at the source or as early as possible in the lifecycle.
Represents selecting a safer material, process, operation, or equipment during design.
Captures controls incorporated into equipment or workplaces so risk reduction is less dependent on worker action.
PtD considers hazards across construction, manufacture, use, maintenance, redesign, disposal, and reuse.
Matches the blueprint requirement to address safety criteria in workplace and facility design.
Matches the blueprint requirement to consider machines, equipment, and tools during design or redesign.
Captures design of work methods, operations, and organization of work to minimize occupational risk.

crossCorpusReuseCandidates.reason: Existing FC reference concept may support D01 C01 but must not be duplicated. Production primary placement will be resolved during corpus authoring and FCP-8.
Existing FC reference concept overlaps elimination-by-design. FCP must determine whether to reuse, merge, or distinguish before learner-ready packaging.

nextGate: Resolve candidate concept boundaries and reuse decisions before authoring d01_c01 learner-ready cards.
